rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/001/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2d 30 2e 31 2e 30 2d } // "-0.1.0-" version string common in C2 traffic
        $b = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $c = "Accept: */*" wide ascii
        $d = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}

A secondary Linux system (WS-IT-101) showed signs of scanning activity but was not central to the breach.
